self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: the equipping character's ATK is increased by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Triggers off-field.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members (the wearer included) is increased by 50%. Triggers off-field, and the DMG bonus does not stack across several copies of this set in the party. Applied as stellarconduct_dmg_, this codebase's key for Stellar Glimmer DMG — correct in a Stellar-Conduct rotation, and it undercounts a Stellar Swirl one, which the evaluator does not implement.
